harness: A script in the session's scratchpad (stress.py, stress_net.py): several game threads in one process, each playing eleven-round games one after another, every decision searched by the C++ search (native_search.search_decision) without Python's lock, 64 simulations to depth 16 with root noise, in a search tree kept from decision to decision, the move drawn from the visit shares. Priors and values: uniform from the C++ search itself (no position encoded); uniform through evaluate_zone (every evaluated position encoded by the zone encoder); or the network of generation 10 of the run of 20 November 22:43, on the CPU, through evaluate_zone.

builds.source: commit b38ee9a (the engine and search of 1463ff4)
